description: Header file defining the MmapTrack class for audio track management in Android's audioflinger component, including methods for track control, mute processing, and buffer handling.

classes.name: MmapTrack
classes.description: Represents a memory-mapped audio track with control over playback, mute state, and buffer management.

methods.name: MmapTrack
methods.description: Constructor initializing the MmapTrack with thread, attributes, format, session, and other parameters.

methods.name: initCheck
methods.description: Checks if the track has been initialized correctly.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts playback with optional synchronization event and session.

methods.name: isFastTrack
methods.description: Returns false, indicating this is not a fast track.

methods.name: appendDumpHeader
methods.description: Appends header info for debugging dump.

methods.name: appendDump
methods.description: Appends dump info, active state included.

methods.name: setSilenced_l
methods.description: Sets the silenced state, protected by lock.

methods.name: isSilenced_l
methods.description: Returns whether the track is silenced, protected by lock.

methods.name: getAndSetSilencedNotified_l
methods.description: Gets and resets the silenced notified flag, protected by lock.

methods.name: processMuteEvent_l
methods.description: Updates mute state and notifies audio service, requires thread lock.
